title: Sikakɔkɔɔ Nantwinini a Wɔpam No
intro: Onipa bi a wɔaka ne ho asɛm wɔ Kur’aan mu no maa nnipadɔm kɛse bi twee wɔn ho fii ho bere a na odiyifo a ɔyɛ ɔdehye biara nni hɔ no. Biribi a wɔde sika kɔkɔɔ ayɛ no gyee ɔman mũ bi koma — nanso saa onipa yi ho asɛm no ba awiei wɔ ankonamyɛ ne nnome a ɛyɛ nwonwa mu. Hena na obetumi ayɛ saa obi a wɔapow no yi?
clues: Mipuei wɔ bere a na odiyifo kɛse bi a waforo akɔgye ɔsoro akwankyerɛ nni hɔ no.
Memaa nnipakuw kɛse bi yeraa de biribi a mede m’ankasa me nsa ayɛ.
Ná ɛte sɛ nea sika kɔkɔɔ abɔde a meyɛe no wɔ nkwa, na ɛma nnyigyei ahorow a ɛma wɔn a wodii akyi no ho dwiriw wɔn.
Mekae sɛ mahu nea afoforo ntumi nhu — nea wonhu no mu kakraa bi.
Metwee biribi fii ɔsoro bɔfo no akwan so na metow guu dade a wɔanwene mu.
Wobuu me fɔ sɛ me nkutoo menkyinkyin, a na nnome soronko bi wom sɛ obiara ntumi mfa ne nsa nka me honam ani na saa ara nso na memfa me nsa nka wɔn de.

arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verse: [Allāh] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray." (20:85)
